title: Can Exercise Electrocardiography Discriminate Hypertensive Heart Disease From Obstructive Coronary Artery Disease? A Multimodality Imaging Study
official: Can Exercise Electrocardiography Discriminate Hypertensive Heart Disease From Obstructive Coronary Artery Disease? A Multimodality Imaging Study

criteria:

* Patients with CAD and LVH
